value.question: Can a person leave a clinical trial after enrolling?
plan: Yes, participants can leave a clinical trial at any time.
They should inform the research team of their decision.
They may need to complete exit procedures as required.

value.draft: Yes, a person can leave a clinical trial at any time. It is important to inform the research team of their decision to withdraw. They may need to complete certain exit procedures, such as returning study materials or completing follow-up questionnaires, as required by the trial protocol. Participants should always discuss their intentions with the research team to ensure their safety and the integrity of the study. Leaving a trial does not affect their right to receive medical care or future participation in other studies.
